description: REVERSE ASIN on Amazon US: every observed keyword (head search terms taken from Amazon's own autocomplete, page 1 observed about once a week) whose latest page 1 shows the product, organically with its rank or in a sponsored unit present in the page HTML, with the keyword's result count, the Overall Pick badge and the date; organic first, best rank first, with totals (keywords, organic, top 10, sponsored, Overall Pick). Pass asins (up to 10, the product first) to COMPARE it with competitors: each keyword row adds every competitor's organic rank, asins_on_page and gap (a competitor on page 1 organically, the product not); gaps=true keeps only those. history=true adds the first product's rank on each keyword over time. USE WHEN the user asks which keywords a product (theirs or a competitor's) shows up for, where competitors are visible and they are not, or how a product's position on a term moved. Coverage is head search terms and page 1 only (the coverage block gives the counts), so a product shows fewer keywords than a full search index would. NOT volume figures and NOT live: dated weekly samples. A product not seen on any observed page is free (asin_not_found). COST: paid plan required (listed only for keys on a paid plan); 1 credit per 25 keywords returned per ASIN compared (+0.5 with history when a keyword has more than one observation). Counts against the derived daily cap (default 2,000 calls per key).

asin.description: A 10-character Amazon ASIN: the keywords it shows up for. Give asin OR asins.

asins.description: Up to 10 ASINs, the product first, then the competitors to compare it with.

country.description: Amazon US only: the map covers amazon.com search.

gaps.description: With asins: only the keywords where a competitor is on page 1 organically and the first product is not.

history.description: Also return the first product's rank on each keyword in every observation; +0.5 credit when a keyword has more than one.

limit.description: Keywords per answer (1 credit per 25 returned, per ASIN).

placement.description: Organic and sponsored (default), organic only, or sponsored only.
